Add a company

Saw a plant or got a referral? Add it here. It shows up right away (marked "added by you") so you can call it, and goes on your request list for Claude to research, rank and add to the master sheet.

Your requests for Claude

Paste it into your Claude chat (phone is fine). Claude researches each one, ranks it, adds it to the sheet and updates this site.
